title: Cold brew: refrigerated concentrate
scope: Covered food-safe home vessel, refrigerated immersion and paper filtration; excludes room-temperature brewing, nitro, canning and commercial production.

sources.title: Guide To Cold Brew
supports: Refrigerated 1:8 mass-ratio concentrate, medium-coarse grind and 14-hour starting steep
Even wetting, paper filtration and equal-parts dilution option

sources.title: How to Use the OXO Compact Cold Brew Coffee Maker
supports: Model-specific coarse concentrate procedure, 20-24-hour refrigerated steep and automatic drainage
Manufacturer's own 14-day claim cannot establish this jar recipe's safe storage life

sources.title: Food Safety: Clean, separate, cook, chill
supports: Hand and utensil cleaning, prompt refrigeration, fridge at 4 degrees Celsius or below

sources.title: Unique Foods Processed at Retail: Cold Brew Coffee
supports: Minnesota retail cold brew treated as time/temperature-controlled food
Retail guidance requires at most 41 F brewing/storage, 7-day date mark and assessment for room-temperature or longer storage; not universal household validation

Dated assessment explicitly not peer-reviewed or comprehensive; its nitro storage limits are not generic jar instructions

sources.title: Food safety and you

recipe.name: Refrigerated jar concentrate: 100 g coffee / 800 g water
equipment: Clean food-safe covered vessel approximately 1.5 L, actual fill limit checked
Clean spoon, sieve, paper filter and stable holder

water_temperature_c.control: Use refrigerated liquid drinking water; hold covered vessel in a refrigerator at 4 C or colder throughout the steep. Upper bound, not an exact extraction setpoint.

recipe.grind_description: Medium-coarse; slightly coarser than ordinary pour-over grounds. No universal grinder setting.

expected_time_s.clock_start: Fully wetted, covered vessel enters the refrigerator after all extraction water is added
expected_time_s.clock_end: Selected 14-hour steep ends and filtration begins; preparation and filtering excluded

recipe.completion_signal: Selected steep elapsed while refrigerated, then grounds separated and useful liquid drained through the filter; elapsed time/appearance do not establish safety.

serving_dilution.provenance: App-selected weighed implementation of Counter Culture's equal-parts dilution

steps.instruction: Clean hands and equipment, rinse, check the vessel fill limit and refrigerator at 4 C or colder.
steps.why: Avoid contaminating a long steep without a hot brewing step.
steps.completion: Clean stable equipment and cold shelf ready.

steps.instruction: Add 100 g grounds and all 800 g refrigerated water; gently stir out dry clumps and cover.
steps.why: Wetting evenly makes the chosen mass ratio meaningful.
steps.completion: All water measured, no dry clumps, vessel covered.

steps.instruction: Place covered vessel in refrigerator, label preparation time and start the selected 14-hour steep.
steps.why: Recipe reference and continuous cold handling remain separate requirements.
steps.completion: 14 hours elapsed while vessel remained refrigerated at 4 C or colder.

steps.instruction: Strain into clean server, paper-filter in portions below the rim; serve or refrigerate promptly.
steps.why: Remove grounds and sediment without inventing a filtration deadline.
steps.completion: Useful liquid collected, grounds separated, concentrate cold or served immediately.

steps.instruction: For one serving combine 100 g collected concentrate with 100 g cold water; record collected batch mass separately.
steps.why: Serving strength is distinct from extraction ratio and variable collected yield.
steps.completion: 200 g prepared serving before optional additions; serving water excluded from extraction totals.

steps.instruction: Discard grounds and paper; wash and dry equipment following its instructions; cover and refrigerate leftovers promptly.
steps.why: Prepare a clean setup for the next batch and maintain cold handling.
steps.completion: Equipment clean and unused concentrate covered and cold.

variants.name: Ready-to-drink extraction
variants.how_it_differs: Uses a separately selected extraction recipe; do not automatically dilute it as this concentrate. Counter Culture discusses undiluted 1:11 as equipment-dependent, not this baseline.

variants.name: OXO Compact manufacturer procedure
variants.how_it_differs: Coarse coffee and model-specific stronger concentrate; 20-24 hours refrigerated, automatic drainage and different dilution. Follow that equipment's fill and seal instructions.

variants.name: Commercial room-temperature or extended storage
variants.how_it_differs: Not covered by this home guide; Minnesota retail guidance calls for product assessment for these processes.

variants.name: Nitro/reduced-oxygen packaging
variants.how_it_differs: Separate process validation and hazards; do not transfer 2017 BCCDC nitro shelf-life numbers to an ordinary covered home vessel.

troubleshooting.check_first: Weighed serving dilution and coffee/water quantities
troubleshooting.adjustment: App suggestion: add measured serving water before changing the next extraction.

troubleshooting.check_first: Excess serving dilution, dose, complete wetting and cold steep clock
troubleshooting.adjustment: App suggestion: reduce dilution first; then try another coffee or one small grind/time change in a later refrigerated batch.

troubleshooting.check_first: Stable filter holder, paper seating, overfill and accumulated grounds
troubleshooting.adjustment: App suggestion: sieve first, filter in portions or replace clogged paper; keep brew cold and avoid forcing an overloaded filter.

safety: Use clean food-safe vessel, lid, utensils and filters; follow their cleaning instructions.
Use refrigerated drinking water and keep covered brew at 4 C or colder throughout the selected steep and storage.
Serve after filtration or cover and refrigerate promptly; keep unused concentrate cold while serving.
No safe home shelf-life duration established for this recipe; do not generalize a manufacturer's 14-day claim.
Smell alone cannot establish safety. Commercial, room-temperature, canned and nitro processes require separate consideration.

app_audit.finding: COLD_BREW has tempRangeLow=20/high=25, defaultRatio=8, coarse grind and 43200-86400 s targets. Temperature contradicts existing refrigerated safety copy.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Align default handling temperature with <=4 C refrigerated guide; retain recipe-specific steep/texture and identify 1:8 as concentrate extraction.

app_audit.finding: Cold steep uses countdown at timeTargetLow (12 h); filter is correctly manual with separate refrigeration safety codes. The 12-24 h coarse generic profile is another starting point, not inherently factually wrong for differing from this selected recipe.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve passive steep/manual filter split. If this selected recipe is integrated, use its 50400 s reference and explicit origin; do not impose it universally or invent a filtration deadline.

app_audit.finding: COLD_BREW estimates 2.0 g/g apparent loss with PROTOCOL_SENSITIVE caveat; documentation correctly distinguishes apparent loss from literal absorption.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve existing caveat and measure collected concentrate where possible; coefficient does not validate this batch yield or diluted serving mass.

app_audit.finding: cold_immersion_generic already uses CollectedConcentrate(2.0), while method-level defaults and calculator retain water-minus-loss cup semantics.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Keep concentrate distinct from prepared servings throughout quantity presentation; measure collected yield and store dilution separately.

app_audit.finding: Cold brew inherits STANDARD decaf policy and subtracts 30 seconds from both endpoints; no method-specific exception in COLD_BREW.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Do not assert universal decaf shortening; use same refrigerated baseline unless a selected recipe supplies evidence.

app_audit.finding: prep_tip_cold_brew and cold brew start/steep/filter strings already instruct clean equipment and <=4 C full steep/prompt refrigeration.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve correct current safety copy; this is not an unresolved room-temperature instruction in these strings.

app_audit.finding: Current preparation, steep, filter and global safety copy already require clean equipment, covered cold storage and caution about smell alone.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve current guidance; add concise concentrate/dilution distinction if this guide is later integrated.

app_audit.finding: No exact cold brew recipe entry found; current P1ExactGuidanceFactualErrata applies other methods. Catalog generic profile does not establish everyday or localization completeness.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Do not report historical exact cold brew recipe errors or imply this research changes app support.

app_audit.finding: Existing COLD_BREW numeric band is specifically keyed to Fellow Ode Gen 2 Brew Burrs with manufacturer URL; not a universal grinder number.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve equipment scope; use texture for this generic guide. This review did not revalidate that grinder chart.

uncertainties: App-selected batch size, weighed dilution, clock origin and sieve/paper workflow have not been physically tested.
No measured collected yield or universal retention coefficient; filtration and total workflow durations depend on setup.
No storage-safe maximum for the generic home recipe verified; regional retail and nitro limits are different applicability scopes.
No reviewed source establishes a universal decaf time reduction.
Hario MCPN PDF URLs could not be opened and FIC PDF returned 403; no snippet-only instructions adopted.
Counter Culture also publishes a different hot-bloom Toddy recipe; it is not combined with this fully refrigerated jar baseline.
English editorial research content only; app execution, translations, accessibility speech and physical brewing unverified.
do_not_claim: Every cold brew should steep at room temperature or every room-temperature process is necessarily unsafe.
Toddy/OXO 14-day refrigerated claims establish safe storage for all cold brew, diluted drinks or milk additions.
Cold storage sterilizes coffee, smell proves safety or an elapsed recipe timer validates food safety.
100 g coffee plus 800 g water guarantees 600 g collected concentrate or 800 g ready-to-drink beverage.
Coffee universally retains exactly 2 g water per g dry coffee.
All decaf cold brew needs a shorter steep or a precise coarser grinder number.
Cold brew universally has lower acidity, higher caffeine or an established health advantage.
Nitro/canned commercial shelf-life rules automatically apply to the covered home vessel.
This guide has been brewed, device-tested, localized or approved for release.
